title: Choose the visual world for TaskDeck
question: The roll assigned Avgang, a Nordic departure-poster timetable. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Avgang
options.thesis: Every task read like a timetable: one row per task, one fixed column per company.
options.viewport: Yellow rail and header; a white timetable where each task row has a fixed column per company, each cell stamped with initials and time.
options.risk: Poster yellow can get loud over a long workday, so it stays on the shell and headers only.

raised.raise: State is carried by form, not hue alone: done is a filled tick, N/A is struck through, open is hollow, overdue is a doubled rule.
Nothing disappears, it cancels: N/A and reopened cells stay visible with who and when.

options.label: Audit Workpaper
options.lineage: auditors' workpaper tickmarks and sign-off columns
options.thesis: Completion shown the way auditors already mark it: a tickmark, initials, a date.
options.viewport: A quiet sidebar and a workpaper table; each company cell holds a tickmark with initials and date, legend at the foot.
options.risk: Closest to what a finance tool already looks like, so it can read as a familiar spreadsheet.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: A task is a line and each company a station that fills when it is done.
options.viewport: A dark shell with each task drawn as a line of company stations, completed stations filled.
options.case: Fuses closest to the fan-out mechanism; a dark ground suits a daytime desk screen less.
options.risk: A diagram can read slower to scan than a table for 12 companies.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Completions are stamps on a coupon, and cancelled things stay on the page.
options.viewport: Each task is a coupon book; company legs show validated, used or void stamps.
options.case: Matches the audit idea best; nostalgia is the cost.
options.risk: Can tip into retro novelty if the stamps are not kept precise.

options.label: Boxed-Module Density
options.thesis: Boxed modules and utility red fit a whole portfolio on one screen.
options.viewport: Ruled task modules with small red tabs, all companies visible without expanding.
options.case: Strongest on density for 12-company rows; weakest on audience identification.
options.risk: Tiny type tests readability for long sessions.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.case: A charcoal spectrogram is a poor daytime desk screen for office staff.
options.kept: State carried by line form, not hue alone.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.case: Too playful for audit work, which you ruled out.
options.kept: Every entity is a fixed, named cell.

options.label: Acetate Tab Board
options.case: Tab-rail navigation and single-size type fight an operating dashboard.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean task list with a blue accent, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, filter bar and an even list of task rows.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
